avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 induction reduces clopidogrel activation and antiplatelet efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; consider alternative antidepressant if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (high-dose supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates antiplatelet effects, increasing bleeding risk synergistically with clopidogrel
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; moderate dietary garlic intake acceptable

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties increase hemorrhage risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue supplement; consult cardiologist before resuming

avoid_supplements.name: Ginger (high-dose supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibits platelet aggregation; additive bleeding risk with clopidogrel
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplements; culinary amounts generally safe

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (fish oil)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; may slightly enhance bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bruising/bleeding; maintain consistent intake if tolerated

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose vitamin E may have mild anticoagulant properties
caution_supplements.action: Limit to ≤400 IU daily; monitor clinical status

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use culinary amounts; avoid high-dose supplements without monitoring

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase clopidogrel levels, but more importantly reduces active metabolite formation via CYP2C19
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice; switch to alternative citrus if desired

caution_foods.name: Cranberry juice (large quantities)
caution_foods.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet properties; excessive intake could potentiate bleeding
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation (≤8 oz daily); monitor for bleeding signs

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (heavy consumption)
caution_foods.mechanism: Alcohol potentiates antiplatelet effects and increases GI bleeding risk
caution_foods.action: Limit to ≤1-2 drinks daily; avoid binge drinking

monitoring_notes: Clopidogrel requires CYP2C19 activation for efficacy; CYP2C19 loss-of-function variants may reduce effectiveness independent of interactions. Monitor for bleeding events and ensure consistent dosing; patients with stents require strict adherence to prevent thrombosis.
